name: Video-Rebirth/hyperflow-h3-flash
title: HyperFlow H3 Flash: Video Rebirth compresses MiniMax-H3 to 13.7B for joint video and audio generation in 4 to 8 steps, with GGUF
summary: Video Rebirth's compressed MiniMax-H3 makes video plus stereo audio in 4 to 8 steps; a Q4_K_M GGUF is 9.1 GB and fits a 24 GB card, though the text encoder needs another 15.7 GB. Official 5.2 s 1344x768 clips take 53 s on an RTX PRO 6000, 83 s on a 5090 and 152 s on a 4090.
